# `ext::archive_plan` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/archive_plan.lani#L2)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Pure allocation-backed raw-byte namespace planner with complete path/type/duplicate/file-ancestor validation, implied/explicit directory coalescing and a sealed terminal state. It parses no archive and performs no filesystem operation. Fixed node/path/entry capacities, checked requested-byte reservation and bounded planning work are explicit; errors retain ordinal/offset and poison later mutation. Direct native contracts and 76 independent modeled namespaces pass, plus a separate four-process allocation baseline/three-reached-ENOMEM receipt with balanced release. Model namespaces are not process counts. Borrowed path/component views end at explicit destroy; no automatic lifetime or hostile-namespace guarantee.
